newsitem.title: USA: Telewest seen issuing $300 mln junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Telewest seen issuing $300 mln junk bonds.

text.p: Telewest Communications Plc is expected to issue about $300 million in U.S. junk bonds via a Morgan Stanley & Co syndicate, market sources said.
The deal, slated for late June or July, will be structured to include either a prefunded interest reserve or zero coupon bonds, said one source close to the deal.

The British cable operator could use the funds to convert its networks to digital technology and for digital set-top boxes for cable TV customers, according to an earlier report in London's Times newspaper.
